arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'pending_booking' kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',(SELECT json_object('flight_id',h.flight_id,'passenger_id',h.passenger_id) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'same_client',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',x.booking_id,'status',x.status,'request_id',x.request_id)) FROM bookings x WHERE x.client_reference=b.client_reference)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'flight' kind,json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) data FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking_error',json_object('status',status,'message',message,'trace',trace_id) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='booking' AND status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 6)

SELECT b.*, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) customer_events FROM bookings b WHERE status IN ('pending','cancelled')
